scores.visual_critic_note: Clean card-based UI chrome and a deliberate teal edge-bundle color (#476376) lift this above generic, but the 900×900 SVG is visibly cropped in the viewport, the light-gray SVG background barely separates from the white card, and the shuffled Tableau10 circles feel incidentally pleasant rather than chosen.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout radii, data-driven domains (d3.extent/root.height), key functions present in all data joins, and sunburst applies scaleSqrt radial correction — but purely topological encoding (no quantitative bars/areas) means most lie-factor rules are untestable, and synthetic uniform-weight data (sum=1 per leaf) limits robustness validation.
scores.stress_test_note: The tension slider fires redrawLinks() (300+ path attr updates) on every input with no RAF/debounce; the force-layout path transition lacks .interrupt() before starting, allowing mid-flight conflicts on rapid layout switches; and mouseover/mouseout are unguarded against touch events causing ghost hover states on mobile.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Technically ambitious (8 layouts, flubber morphing, 300 bundled edges over ~200 nodes) but the default Circle Pack view is overwhelmed by dense edge bundles converging into a dark tangle that obscures the hierarchical structure — interaction-based fading helps but the static baseline is hard to parse.

proposer: 816 lines, down from 832 (-16 lines). Compacted the FPS transition handlers by extracting repeated `d3.select("#fps-display")`, consolidating the `measuring` flag, and collapsing multi-line property cleanups. Removed 4 CSS comments and an extra blank line.
